messages:
Maya: okay real talk — who else did a double-take at the kazoo solo? :face_with_monocle:
Ibrahim: that was peak chaos in the best way. 10/10 for surprise energy 44f
Rina: popcorn.gif :popcorn: (couldn't stop giggling)
Luis: snack poll time: Boston cream donuts vs empanadas? react with :doughnut: or :pierogi:
Haley: empanadas forever. demo snacks should be hand-held and dramatic :sparkles: (also napkin provision?)
Maya: I can bring napkins and a box of mixers (coffee + tea) 375
Ibrahim: shoutout to infra — the deploy demo didn't explode and that made my heart so happy :heart_eyes:
Rina: can we get a short transcript for the demo? watching without sound later is a struggle
ops-bot: Note: transcript request logged. Follow-up to be posted in #eng-docs.
Haley: also tiny contest idea: worst kazoo impression wins the leftover snack box next week :trophy: 
Luis: submitting my audition tape now (low bar)
sticker-bot: <sticker:confetti-dance>
Maya: low-stakes volunteer ask: community outreach for the meetup — who can spare 2 hrs next Sat? thumbs-up if yes :+1:
Ibrahim: thumbs up from me. happy to help set up tables and wrangle name tags
Rina: I'll come early to help with tech setup. also will bring power strips :electric_plug:
Haley: quick poll closure: in-person post-hands at HQ lobby (react :round_pushpin:) or virtual hangout (react :video_camera:)?
Maya: dang decisions. I'll flip a coin but will accept bribes in snack form
ops-bot: Poll results: Donuts 7, Empanadas 4. In-person 3, Virtual 6.
Ibrahim: donuts it is. cake-style victory for carbs
Rina: who wants to curate tomorrow's memes channel takeover? loser of snack poll gets duty? :wink:
Luis: can we instead do alternating custody of the memes channel? compromise: loser hosts once and brings snacks next time
Haley: fine by me. also someone tag the recorder for captions please — accessibility win
Maya: noted, ops will post captions link when available. big love to everyone who pulled late hours prepping this afternoon :hugs:
Ibrahim: evening team — may your queues be short and your snacks be warm :zzz:
Rina: leaving with a kazoo earworm and a craving for Boston cream. goodnight :crescent_moon:
